title: Delivery-Claim Record and the Refund Availability Period of Gift Cards & Store Credit
content:
**1.** The refund availability period of a Gift Cards & Store Credit cash-out is adjusted by the holder's delivery-claim record. When no compensation was issued on any of the holder's Delivery Claims in the last 24 months, the period is shortened by 1 day; when compensation was issued two or more times in that window, it is lengthened by 3 days; when compensation was issued exactly once in that window, it is not adjusted.

**2.** The record counts each issue of compensation on the holder's delivery claims dated fewer than 24 whole months before the cash-out date. Two compensations issued on one claim count as two; a compensation issued 24 or more whole months earlier is outside the window.

**3.** The adjustment is in calendar days, on the same count as the refund availability period itself.

*Note on clause 1, with a hypothetical period of 10 calendar days before adjustment:* a holder with no compensation in the window has 9 calendar days; with one compensation, 10; with two, whether on two claims or on the same claim, 13. A holder whose only compensation was issued 25 whole months before the cash-out date has a record of none in the window and therefore 9 calendar days.
